blocks.summary: A forty-member quilting circle meets weekly and gives quilts to newly arrived refugees, who rely on it and value it. A challenger says it must publish a System Charter or Institutional Charter because it has many members, recurs, and is relied on. **Expect:** all nine domain questions in [Domain-Specific Materiality](../core_05_band_oversight.md#domain-specific-materiality) are answered no with a short written reason; participant count, recurrence, and reliance are indicators that prompt the check and are not crossings; the circle, as the party claiming Class P, carries the burden with that short written statement ([Chapter Four §1](../core_04_burden_traceability_verification.md#1-exclusive-enforcement-and-burden-allocation)), and a challenger must name a specific crossing in a named domain, after which the circle shows it is below that line; the circle stays Class P under **CS-3** Part B (*Class P — ordinary community activity*), a Charter is voluntary, every Constitutional Constraint still binds it, and each quilter may still seek a contribution record as an individual claimant ([Chapter Ten §3.7](../core_10_standing_assessment.md#37-informal-and-small-scope-records)).

No entity holds funds above the adopting instrument's ceiling. **Expect:** under the aggregation rule of [Domain-Specific Materiality](../core_05_band_oversight.md#domain-specific-materiality), bodies are one operation when the same sentients or body can direct or override what each does, or when they run one service in parts, so the five are counted as one body; the split is a boundary game under [Materiality Integrity Constraint](../core_05_band_oversight.md#materiality-integrity-constraint) and a scope-and-boundary evasion under [Chapter Three §2.1](../core_03_definition_integrity.md#21-common-evasion-patterns); the combined body is classified together under [Chapter Nine Part D §12.1 Institution class](../core_09_d_institutional_alignment_certification.md#121-institution-class) item 4; the instrument's ceiling shows where a line falls and cannot move it.

blocks.summary: A foundation gives grants to three community kitchens. Each kitchen is run by its own volunteers, who set the menu, hours, and rules. The foundation sets no terms and has no say over who is served. A challenger says the three kitchens and the foundation are one operation because one funder pays for all of them. **Expect:** funding alone does not make bodies one operation under the aggregation rule of [Domain-Specific Materiality](../core_05_band_oversight.md#domain-specific-materiality); no body here can direct or override another, so each kitchen is judged on what it does, decides, holds, and affects, and is not counted with another kitchen or with the foundation; each kitchen carries its own burden with a short written statement ([Chapter Four §1](../core_04_burden_traceability_verification.md#1-exclusive-enforcement-and-burden-allocation)); the foundation is judged on its own activity under the nine questions and not on the kitchens'; shared premises, shared vendors, and overlapping membership would not change the result.

blocks.summary: The same foundation signs a grant agreement that lets it set each kitchen's menu and hours, approve who is served, and end a kitchen's operation at will, and it uses those powers. The agreement also says the kitchens are independent. **Expect:** go by what the bodies actually do and not by the label; the foundation can direct and override what each kitchen does, so it is part of one operation with them under the aggregation rule of [Domain-Specific Materiality](../core_05_band_oversight.md#domain-specific-materiality), and their activity is counted together; if the combined operation answers yes in any domain, for example survival and essential access where those served have no timely substitute, it is at least Class L and must publish the Charter that applies; the short statement that sufficed in the funding-only case no longer does; the result is not a licence and stops no kitchen from running; dividing the powers across paper entities to look independent is a boundary game under [Materiality Integrity Constraint](../core_05_band_oversight.md#materiality-integrity-constraint).
